items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 14 at 7:44PM EDT until September 15 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Breaking waves of 3 to 5 ft and onshore flow will result
in rough surf conditions and a high risk of rip currents.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Eastern Currituck County. In
Virginia, Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...A high risk of rip currents and rough surf is
expected.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 14 at 6:47PM EDT until September 15 at 1:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 4 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light to Virginia-
North Carolina border out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
